units.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
units.meaning: If there are material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity, such discrepancies must be documented by submitting one or more of the documents listed in this section.

units.quote: (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C))
scope_quotes: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
units.meaning: An exception to the requirement to document material name discrepancies using the documents listed in this section applies to married names as provided in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, court orders or decrees constitute an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, name change orders are acceptable court orders or decrees for documenting a material name change.

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, divorce decrees are acceptable court orders or decrees for documenting a material name change.

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, marriage certificates are an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.

units.quote: (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, documentation demonstrating a change of name by operation of state law is an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.
